scope: F3 historical 4 validation and 12 development extrapolation cases; all 835 future frames and 34560 particles
completion_semantics: Finite full-horizon completion is distinct from physical validity. Physics violations retained separately.

protocol.position_scale: registered characteristic geometry length in metres
protocol.case_denominator: all registered future frames, excluding initial state
protocol.aggregation: case mean within family, then equal-weight family mean
protocol.selection: complete case fraction descending, score ascending, update ascending
protocol.confidence_interval_unit: independent physical case, never frame or particle
